names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Ιανουαρίου, «Αγία Μαργαρίτα η Νέα Οσιομάρτυς», with the rank words left off.

Name page 9865 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Маргарита (Гунаронуло), игумения, прмц.»; the office and the rank are stripped and the surname the calendar keeps in parentheses stays. The folder held only the Greek «Μαργαρίτα». The day line gives the bare genitive «Маргариты». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; `margarita-zakachurina` carries a different surname.

death.note: saint.gr's heading dates her «(; - 1918)», and the life puts her arrest in the days after «το Σεπτέμβριο του 1918 μ.Χ. έφυγαν τα στρατεύματα των «λευκών» από το Καζάν». The page gives no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 августа ст. ст. — «Прмц. Маргариты (1918).»

attestations.note: The day's eighth and last entry. THIS IS AN IDENTIFICATION AND NOT A MATCH ON A DAY: the Russian line gives a bare forename, a rank and a year, and the folder's only venerated row is a Greek 25 January, so nothing in the two days connects them and the reading is the whole of the case. Four things agree and the fourth is the one that settles it. The rank: «Прмц.» is преподобномученица, the `venerable-martyr` the folder's `types` already carry. The office: name page 9865 says «игумения», abbess, which is the folder's other type. The year: «(1918)» is the 1918 the folder already holds, with saint.gr putting her death in the days after the Whites left Kazan in September 1918. And the surname the name page keeps in parentheses, «Гунаронуло», is a Greek one — saint.gr's life says outright that the abbess Margarita of the Menzelinsk monastery «ήταν ελληνικής καταγωγής», of Greek descent, and that she ordered her house after the pattern of the monasteries of Greece. An abbess named Margarita, of Greek family, a venerable-martyr of 1918 in the Kazan country, is one woman and not two. NO `dates` WERE TOUCHED. The day page prints no hymn under her name, and no life page stands behind the Russian line. KEPT AND STRENGTHENED, 13 October 2026, ON A FIFTH AGREEMENT THAT ANSWERS THE OBJECTION ABOVE. This row was flagged as the one in its block resting on a reading rather than on a day and a name, because the folder's only other venerated row is a Greek 25 January and nothing was thought to connect the two days. Something does. Her name page 9865 heads «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 9 августа» — the Russian calendar keeps her twice, and the January keeping is her place in the Собор новомучеников и исповедников Церкви Русской, which the day page for 26 января ст. ст. carries as its first entry in a year when that day is «Неделя о блудном сыне», a Sunday, so the synaxis is the moveable observance of the 25 января commemoration and not a fixed 26th. And saint.gr's 25 Ιανουαρίου listing is the Russian 25 января list read in Greek: Γρηγόριος ο Θεολόγος against Свт. Григория Богослова, Πούπλιος against Прп. Поплия Сирийского, Μάρης against Прп. Мара певца, Μωυσής Νόβγκοροντ against Свт. Моисея архиеп. Новгородского, Ανατόλιος της Όπτινα against Прп. Анатолия Оптинского, and Βλαδίμηρος Μητροπολίτης Κιέβου against Сщмч. Владимира митр. Киевского (1918) — six entries line for line, one of them a Russian new martyr of 1918 like her. «Αγία Μαργαρίτα η Νέα Οσιομάρτυς» stands in that same Greek list with no Russian 25 января counterpart, which is what a Greek synaxarist does with a Russian new martyr whose own calendar keeps her on the new martyrs' day. So the Greek 25 January and the Russian 26 января (Новомуч.) are one commemoration a day apart by this year's Sunday, and the 9 августа of this row is her own calendar's second day for her. WHAT THE RE-READING OF saint.gr's OWN PAGE 4269 ADDED AND WHAT IT DID NOT. It confirms every one of the four earlier agreements in the page's own words: «Η μοναχή Μαργαρίτα, ηγουμένη της Ι. Μονής Αγίου Ιωάννου Προδρόμου στην πόλη Μενζελίνσκ, είχε ελληνική καταγωγή» — a nun, an abbess, of Greek descent; «Οσιομάρτυς» in the heading against «прмц.»; «(; - 1918)» against «(1918)»; and the execution in the days after «το Σεπτέμβριο του 1918 μ.Χ. έφυγαν τα στρατεύματα των «λευκών» από το Καζάν», which is the Kazan country the Menzelinsk house stands in. It gives her NO surname anywhere, so «Гунаронуло» is the Russian calendar's alone and is not corroborated from the Greek side; it gives no exact date of death and names no day but 25 Ιανουαρίου; and its two references, the Μονή Παντοκράτορος Μελισσοχωρίου and ΒΗΜΑ ΟΡΘΟΔΟΞΙΑΣ, were not followed. `margarita-zakachurina` was checked again and remains a different woman, of 1937. The «Дни памяти» line is read and not copied, per BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2, so no row is made for the January synaxis and this folder renders on 9 августа ст. ст. and on the Greek 25 January only.
